heroHeadline: PLA 13 Sorties (10 Cross Median Line — N/SW/E ADIZ); PORCUPINE Act Passes House FA 45-0; 10 Senators Blast Trump Summit Ambiguity; HIMARS Deadline 12 Days
heroSubtitle: PLA activity surged sharply on May 19: 13 aircraft sorties with 10 crossing the median line into northern, southwestern, and eastern ADIZ sectors simultaneously — the highest post-Trump-Xi-summit sortie count, nearly doubling the May 18 baseline of 7 sorties (5 crossing). The multi-sector N+SW+E geometry matches the major pressure patterns seen on May 7 (22 sorties), May 2 (29 sortie record), and April 26 (28 sorties), signaling a deliberate post-summit PLA escalation rather than routine gray-zone rotation. Five PLAN vessels and 2 official ships also operating around Taiwan. On the diplomatic front, the US House Foreign Affairs Committee voted 45-0 to pass the PORCUPINE Act, which elevates Taiwan to the same arms-sale legal status as Australia, Israel, and Japan — a significant bipartisan counter-signal to Trump's post-Beijing arms ambiguity. Ten senators simultaneously issued a joint statement declaring themselves 'deeply disturbed' by Trump's failure to address Taiwan's defense at the summit. Speaker Johnson reaffirmed: 'Taiwan needs to stay independent and secure.' USTR Greer's May 17-18 assertion that there is 'no change in American policy' on Taiwan arms now has a legislative counterpart. The HIMARS payment deadline (May 31) is 12 days away. Full May PLA sortie sequence: 4→29→1→2→1→0→22→12→8→12→7→9→2→3→15→6→7→13.
